text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Estonian and Russian Foreign Ministers will meet on November 5 in Petroskoy to discuss border agreements and economic issues.

- The State Court rejected the appeal of three men sentenced to death for the brutal murder five elderly pensioners in the village of Saka in 1994. The Viru regional court sentenced to death a man who had beaten and burned to death a police officer and one other man.
- Narva city re-elected Raivo Murd as Mayor and Anatoli Paal as chairman of the council.
- British custom specialists will visit Tallinn in November to consult the Estonian Government on the privatization of customs services.
